_doc: 小朋友鎮的職業。place＝考試／上班的地點（buildings 的 id），npc＝主考官（npcs 的 id）。exam＝執照考試 10 題：選擇題 {q, zh, opts, a}（a＝正確選項的位置）；打字題 {q, zh, type:'typed', a, alts}（q 裡的 ___ 要打的字）。答對 8 題以上拿執照，可以重考。uniform＝制服：top 上衣顏色、hat 帽子（chef／helmet／cap／nurse）、extra 配件（apron／bag／tie／stethoscope／badge）。task＝工作小任務：kind 'cases'（照資料出 3 題）、'judge'（老師改句子）、'change'（找錢，程式出題）、'order'（點餐，程式出題）、'go'（照英文走到目的地）。

exam.q: Class starts. What does the teacher say?
A student raises a hand. What do you say?
exam.zh: 有學生舉手，你要說什麼？
opts: Yes, Ben? Do you have a question?

exam.q: You want the students to open their books.
Please ___ your name on the paper.
A student gets the answer right.
exam.zh: 學生答對了，你要說什麼？

exam.q: The classroom is too noisy.
exam.zh: 教室太吵了，你要說什麼？

exam.q: Let's ___ the song together.
A student looks sad. What do you ask?
exam.zh: 有學生看起來很難過，你要問什麼？

exam.q: Class is over. See you ___!
What does a teacher do?

task.title: 幫學生改句子
task.intro: Ms. Lin says: Please check the students' sentences.
task.introZh: 林老師說：請幫忙看看學生說的句子對不對。

items.says: He go to school every day.
items.fix: He goes to school every day.
wrong: He going to school every day.

items.says: Yesterday I went to the park.
wrong: Yesterday I go to the park.
Yesterday I goed to the park.

exam.q: A patient comes in. What do you ask first?
exam.zh: 病人進來了，你先問什麼？

exam.q: A boy says, "My head hurts." What does he have?
exam.zh: 男孩說「我的頭好痛」，他怎麼了？

exam.q: Open your ___ and say "Ah."
A girl has a fever. What do you say?
exam.zh: 女孩發燒了，你要說什麼？

exam.q: You want to know how the patient feels.
exam.zh: 你想知道病人覺得怎麼樣。
opts: How many books do you have?

exam.q: Take this medicine three ___ a day.
A boy has a bad cough. What should he do?
exam.zh: 男孩咳得很厲害，他應該怎麼做？
opts: He should play in the rain.

exam.q: I have a ___. My tooth hurts.
The patient feels better now. What do you say?
exam.zh: 病人好多了，你要說什麼？

exam.q: Where does a doctor work?

task.title: 幫病人選藥
task.intro: Dr. Chen says: Please help the patients. Listen and choose the right medicine.
task.introZh: 陳醫生說：請幫忙看病人，聽他們說哪裡不舒服，選對的藥。

cases.says: My head hurts and I feel very hot.
cases.a: Here is some fever medicine. Please rest in bed.
wrong: Here is a bandage for your knee.

cases.a: Here is some cough syrup. Drink warm water, too.
wrong: Put this ice pack on your arm.

cases.says: I fell down and cut my knee.
cases.a: Let me clean it and put on a bandage.

cases.says: My stomach hurts. I ate too much.
cases.a: Here is some stomach medicine. Eat slowly next time.
wrong: Let me put on a bandage.

cases.says: My eyes are red and itchy.
cases.a: Here are some eye drops. Don't rub your eyes.

cases.says: I hit my arm on the door. It hurts a lot.
cases.a: Put this ice pack on your arm.

cases.says: I have a runny nose and I keep sneezing.
cases.a: You have a cold. Here is some cold medicine.
wrong: Let me put on a bandage.
Put this ice pack on your head.

exam.q: A customer comes in. What do you say?
exam.zh: 客人進來了，你要說什麼？

exam.q: The customer asks, "How much is this pencil?"
exam.zh: 客人問：「這枝鉛筆多少錢？」

exam.q: This bag is fifty ___.
The customer wants a red cup, but you only have blue ones.
exam.zh: 客人要紅色的杯子，可是只有藍色的。
opts: Sorry, we only have blue ones.

exam.q: A toy is eighty dollars. The customer gives you one hundred dollars.
exam.zh: 玩具八十元，客人給你一百元，要找多少？
opts: Here's your change. It's twenty dollars.
Here's your change. It's eighty dollars.
Here's your change. It's ten dollars.

exam.q: Thank you. Please come ___!
The customer is looking for milk.
opts: The milk is next to the eggs.

exam.q: How ___ are these apples?
Which number is "sixty-five"?
The customer says, "I'll take it." What does it mean?
exam.zh: 客人說 I'll take it. 是什麼意思？

task.title: 幫客人找錢
task.intro: Mr. Lee says: Please help at the counter. Give the right change.
task.introZh: 李老闆說：請幫忙顧櫃台，算對要找多少錢。

exam.q: A customer sits down. What do you ask?
exam.zh: 客人坐下來了，你要問什麼？
opts: What would you like to eat?

exam.q: "I'd like a bowl of noodles." What does the customer want?
Would you like ___ tea? Yes, please.
exam.zh: 你要「一些」茶嗎？好，麻煩你。

exam.q: The soup is very hot.
Which food is sweet?
I'm ___. Can I have some food, please?
exam.zh: 我「餓了」，可以給我一點吃的嗎？

exam.q: The customer doesn't want any more food.
exam.zh: 客人吃飽了，他會說什麼？

exam.q: "Three eggs, please." How many eggs?
Here is your food. Enjoy your ___!
exam.zh: 這是你的餐點，請慢用（享用你的「餐點」）！

exam.q: What should you do before you cook?
exam.zh: 煮東西之前要先做什麼？

task.title: 照點菜送餐
task.intro: Chef Tom says: Listen to the order and choose the right tray.
task.introZh: 湯姆主廚說：聽客人點什麼，選對的餐盤送過去。

exam.q: There's a fire! Which number do you call in Taiwan?
exam.zh: 台灣的火警電話是幾號？

exam.q: What does a firefighter say to people in a fire?
exam.zh: 火災時消防員會對大家說什麼？

exam.q: Don't ___ in the building. Walk outside.
exam.zh: 不要在大樓裡「跑」，走出去。

exam.q: There is a lot of smoke. What should you do?
opts: Stay low and cover your nose.
Stand up and sing a song.

exam.q: Please ___ the stairs. Don't take the elevator.
exam.zh: 請「使用」樓梯，不要搭電梯。

exam.q: What does "Turn left" mean?
What does "Go straight and turn right" mean?
The fire station is ___ to the hospital.
A cat is stuck in a tree. What do you say?
exam.zh: 有一隻貓卡在樹上，你要說什麼？

exam.q: "The fire is behind the school." Where is the fire?

task.title: 照指示去救火
task.intro: Sam says: Fire! Read the directions and run to the fire.
task.introZh: 消防員山姆說：失火了！看懂英文指示，跑去滅火。
task.arrive: You found the fire! Spray the water!

calls.en: Fire at the school! Go out of the fire station and turn right. Go straight. Pass the hospital and the restaurant. The school is on your right.
calls.zh: 學校失火了！走出消防隊右轉，一直走，經過醫院和餐廳，學校在你的右邊。

calls.en: Fire at the post office! Go out and turn right. Go straight for a long time and cross the big road. The post office is on your left, next to the shop.
calls.zh: 郵局失火了！出去右轉，一直走，過大馬路，郵局在你的左邊，在商店旁邊。

calls.en: Fire at the animal hospital! Go out and turn left. The animal hospital is across the road, on your right.
calls.zh: 動物醫院失火了！出去左轉，動物醫院在馬路對面、你的右邊。

calls.en: Fire at the orange house! Go out and cross the road. Walk past the park. At the next road, turn right. The orange house is on your left.
calls.zh: 橘色房子失火了！出去過馬路，經過公園，到下一條路右轉，橘色房子在你的左邊。

calls.en: Fire at the light blue house! Go out and turn right. At the big road, turn left. Go straight and cross the next road. The light blue house is on your left.
calls.zh: 淺藍色房子失火了！出去右轉，到大馬路左轉，一直走過下一條路，淺藍色房子在你的左邊。

calls.en: Fire at the restaurant! Go out and turn right. Pass the hospital and cross the big road. The restaurant is on your right.
calls.zh: 餐廳失火了！出去右轉，經過醫院、過大馬路，餐廳在你的右邊。

exam.q: What does a mail carrier bring?
"The house is between the bank and the park." Where is the house?
The letter is ___ the box.
Where do you put a stamp?
The cat is ___ the table.
"It's across from the school." Where is it?
Someone opens the door. What do you say?
exam.zh: 有人來開門了，你要說什麼？
opts: Hello! Here's a letter for you.

exam.q: The dog is in ___ of the house.
What is an "address"?
"The post office is next to the shop." What does it mean?

task.title: 送信
task.intro: Molly says: Please read the letter and take it to the right place.
task.introZh: 郵差茉莉說：請看信上的英文，送到對的地方。

calls.en: This letter is for Grandpa Joe. He lives in the yellow house. It is between the pink house and the green house.
calls.zh: 這封信要給喬爺爺。他住在黃色房子，在粉紅色和綠色房子中間。

calls.en: This package is for Lily. She lives in the orange house. It is between the light blue house and the purple house.
calls.zh: 這個包裹要給莉莉。她住在橘色房子，在淺藍色和紫色房子中間。

calls.en: This letter is for Dr. Chen. She works at the hospital. The hospital is next to the fire station.
calls.zh: 這封信要給陳醫生。她在醫院工作，醫院在消防隊旁邊。

calls.en: This box is for Dr. Amy. She works at the animal hospital. It is next to the park.
calls.zh: 這個箱子要給艾咪獸醫。她在動物醫院工作，就在公園旁邊。

calls.en: This letter is for Ms. Lin. She works at the school. The school is next to the restaurant.
calls.zh: 這封信要給林老師。她在學校工作，學校在餐廳旁邊。

calls.en: This letter is for Chef Tom. The restaurant is between the school and the hospital.
calls.zh: 這封信要給湯姆主廚。餐廳在學校和醫院中間。

calls.en: This package is for the purple house. The purple house is next to the orange house.
calls.zh: 這個包裹要送到紫色房子，紫色房子在橘色房子旁邊。

calls.en: This letter is for the pink house. The pink house is next to the yellow house. It is not the green house!
calls.zh: 這封信要送到粉紅色房子。粉紅色房子在黃色房子旁邊，不是綠色那間喔！

calls.en: This box is for Mr. Lee. His shop is next to the post office.
calls.zh: 這個箱子要給李老闆。他的商店在郵局旁邊。

exam.q: A girl brings her dog in. What do you ask?
exam.zh: 女孩帶狗來了，你要問什麼？

exam.q: "My cat doesn't want to eat." What's wrong?
Rabbits like to eat ___.
The dog's leg hurts. What do you say?
exam.zh: 狗的腳受傷了，你要說什麼？
opts: Let me look at its leg.

exam.q: Which animal has long ears?
Be ___ with the little kitten.
How do you say 「牠很健康」 in English?
"The bird can't fly. Its wing hurts." What hurts?
Give the dog some ___ to drink.
The pet feels better. What does the owner say?
exam.zh: 寵物好了，主人會說什麼？

task.title: 照顧生病的寵物
task.intro: Dr. Amy says: Read about each pet. Then choose the right care.
task.introZh: 艾咪獸醫說：讀一讀每隻寵物的情況，選出對的照顧方法。

cases.says: This pet has long ears and a short tail. It loves carrots. It hurt its foot.
cases.zh: 這隻寵物有長耳朵、短尾巴，愛吃紅蘿蔔。牠的腳受傷了。
cases.a: Put a bandage on the rabbit's foot.
wrong: Put a bandage on the cat's foot.
Give the rabbit some eye drops.

cases.says: This pet says "meow." It has a cold and it sneezes a lot.
cases.zh: 這隻寵物會「喵」。牠感冒了，一直打噴嚏。
cases.a: Give the cat some cold medicine.
wrong: Give the dog some cold medicine.

cases.says: This pet says "woof." It ate too much and its stomach hurts.
cases.zh: 這隻寵物會「汪」。牠吃太多，肚子痛。
cases.a: Give the dog some stomach medicine.
wrong: Give the bird some stomach medicine.

cases.says: This pet can fly and sing. One of its wings hurts.
cases.zh: 這隻寵物會飛、會唱歌。牠有一邊翅膀受傷了。

cases.says: This pet lives in water. It isn't swimming well. Its water is dirty.
cases.zh: 這隻寵物住在水裡，游不太動，牠的水髒了。

cases.says: This little pet has round ears and loves seeds. Its eye is red.
cases.zh: 這隻小寵物有圓耳朵、愛吃種子，牠的眼睛紅紅的。
cases.a: Give the hamster some eye drops.
wrong: Give the cat some eye drops.

cases.says: This pet says "meow." It has a thorn in its paw.
cases.zh: 這隻寵物會「喵」，牠的腳掌有一根刺。
cases.a: Take the thorn out of the cat's paw.
wrong: Take the thorn out of the rabbit's ear.
Give the cat some cough syrup.
